name: Qdrant Vector Store
category_description: AI cluster root node (agent, chain, vector store)
description: Use the Qdrant node to interact with your Qdrant collection as a vector store[^1]. You can insert documents into a vector database, get documents from a vector database, retrieve documents to provide them to a retriever connected to a chain[^2] or connect it directly to an agent[^3] to use as a tool[^4]
